name: Spaghetti with Pistachio Pesto
ingredients:
150g raw pistachios
1 garlic clove
10 basil leaves
1tsp raw pine nuts
40g parmesan, cut into small pieces
pinch of sea salt
100ml extra virgin olive oil
400g spaghetti
handful or roughly chopped raw pistachios to serve
directions:
This is another 'nut in the mortar' sauce from Sicily. The peso is excellent with gnocchi or penne.

Blanch the pistachios by plunging them briefly in boiled water. Drain and when cool enough to handle, peel off the skins.

If using a Mortal and Pestle :-
      Using a mortal and pestle, pound the pistachios will until fine, then transfer to a mixing bowl and set aside.

      Place the garlic, basil, pine nuts, parmesan and salt in the mortar and pound together until the mixture has a creamy consistency. 

      Stir in the olive oil, then transfer to the bowl with the pistachios. Mix thoroughly, adding enough olive oil to amalgamate everything nicely.

If using a blender:-
      Place the pistachios, garlic, basil, pine nuts, parmesan, salt and olive oil in the blender, pulse at the lowest speed until the mixture has a creamy consistency. 

      Transfer to a bowl and stir in more olive oil, if necessary.

Cook the spaghetti in plenty of boiling water until al dente.

While the past is cooking, place the pesto in a service bowl big enough to hold the pasta, add a tablespoon of the pasta cooking water and mix well. 

Drain  the spaghetti, and toss it gently with the pesto.

Scatter with chopped pistachios and serve immediately.
